plan.notes: Source: the official University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering four-year plan page 'Computer Science Four-Year Plan (B.S. in Computer Science)', revised 03/2026, at https://cse.umn.edu/college/four-year-plans/computer-science-four-year-plan. Catalog year 2026-2027 reflects the current catalog cycle matching this March 2026 revision. Transcription method: hand-transcribed from the official page's term-by-term tables on 2026-09-30; all course codes, titles, credit values in [Ncr] brackets, and prerequisite/co-requisite markers are from that page. Caveats: the page is explicitly a sample plan, not a guarantee of course availability (alternative options are on APAS or the catalog page). Slots with variable official credits were fixed at the stated values to total exactly 120: Liberal Education slots (official 3 or 4 cr) at 3 except one WRIT-1301-or-LibEd slot at 4; Additional Science (official +/- list: Chem 1071/65, Phys 1302W, ESci 2201 fall-only, Psy 3011, GCD 3022) at 4; UD Math Oriented Requirement (3 or 4 cr) at 3; technical electives at 3 or 4 (UD math 3 cr + technical electives 25 cr = 28 cr, above the official 23-credit minimum, with at least 11 of 23 from CSci courses as the page requires); open electives (only if needed to reach 120) at 4. Bold-face items (CSE 1001, ESci 2201) are fall-only offerings per the page. The department's recommended degree name is the B.S. in Computer Science (listed as 'Computer Science B.S. Comp.Sc.' in UMN Twin Cities undergraduate programs); no silent substitution was made.
